description: This file defines the Application subclass 'InjectedApplication' which initializes and manages a Dagger ObjectGraph for dependency injection within an Android application. It provides methods for setting up the object graph and injecting dependencies into other objects.

classes.name: InjectedApplication
classes.description: An Android Application subclass that manages dependency injection via Dagger's ObjectGraph.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Overridden method that initializes the ObjectGraph upon application startup.

methods.name: initObjectGraph
methods.description: Initializes the Dagger ObjectGraph with a given module or null for testing purposes.

methods.name: inject
methods.description: Injects dependencies into the specified object, if the ObjectGraph has been initialized.
